glosses: same; identical; one and the same; indicates that the two compared noun clauses both represent the one thing
similar; alike; practically identical; indicates that the two compared noun clauses have one or more matching qualities
self; emphasizes the identity or singularity of the modified noun phrase

examples.text: ¿Le gustan las mismas cosas que a mí?
examples.en: Do you like the same things I do?
